platform_name: Quantum Secure Encryption Corp. QPA v2
product_brief: Enterprise post-quantum cryptographic migration platform for assessing posture and planning migration.
pqc_capability_description: QPA v2 is an enterprise post-quantum cryptographic migration platform that transforms fragmented, manual processes into structured, data-driven workflows. It provides real-time visibility into quantum readiness, risk levels, and migration progress. It includes a PQC Planning Wizard for governance, budgeting, and strategy; AI-enhanced assessment modules for cryptographic posture and compliance; integrated inventory analysis for software, hardware, and cryptographic components; and centralized executive dashboards. It is designed to support the transition to post-quantum cryptographic standards.
cryptographic_discovery_&_inventory: Yes. Integrated inventory analysis covers software, hardware, and cryptographic components, identifying risk exposure across complex environments.
deployment_&_migration_complexity: Supports planning, assessment, and execution layers. Provides structured, repeatable framework for assessing current state, prioritizing risk, and planning migration.
organizational_readiness: Supports governance design, budgeting, timelines, and migration strategy development via PQC Planning Wizard.

product_brief: Software-driven hardware cryptography framework with RTL modules controlled by generic C.
pqc_capability_description: Supports LMS (KeyGen, SigGen, SigVer), ML-DSA (KeyGen, SigGen, SigVer), ML-KEM (EncapDecap, KeyGen), and SLH-DSA (KeyGen, SigGen, SigVer). Implemented as RTL hardware modules controlled by software.
crypto_primitives: LMS, ML-DSA, ML-KEM, SLH-DSA, SHA3-224, SHA3-256, SHA3-384, SHA3-512, SHAKE-128, SHAKE-256
fips_validated: Yes (First Validated: 5/26/2026; listed under Cryptographic Algorithm Validation Program)
primary_platforms: Ubuntu 24.04 on RISC-V RV32IM_ZICR and AMD Artix-7 AC701 FPGA
